{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Leggings, high-waisted, knee-length, #745a3b, technical stretch knit.
Long-sleeved top, relaxed fit, hip-length, #d1ab86, breathable cotton-blend jersey.
Blazer-style jacket, structured but soft, waist-length, #e0bd9a, fine-gauge wool blend.
White canvas slip-on shoes, rounded toe, cream, smooth leather and canvas hybrid.

This outfit balances your need for movement during morning yoga with a polished look for your coffee outing, adhering to the everyday dress code while respecting your wish to avoid sneakers. The stretch knit leggings allow for freedom of motion, while the jersey top provides comfort without sacrificing style. The neutral-toned jacket adds structure and warmth suitable for an autumn morning, elevating the activewear into neat casual attire. The slip-on shoes complete the ensemble without violating your specific refusal regarding footwear choices, ensuring a practical yet stylish transition from exercise to socializing."}
